fixed_transform_class.name: EXCLUSIVE_COMMON_DISJUNCTION_TSEITIN_PROXY
definition: Choose r>=2 original input literals l1,...,lr on distinct variables whose variables occur only inside one repeated common-disjunction block of clauses (l1 OR ... OR lr OR R_i).
Replace that common r-literal disjunction in every block clause by a fresh shared proxy y, giving (y OR R_i).

Add any exact CNF definition enforcing y iff (l1 OR ... OR lr); for r=2 the standard definition is (not l1 OR y), (not l2 OR y), (l1 OR l2 OR not y), after normalizing literal signs by renaming/complementing inputs.
fixed_transform_class.exactness: The definitional CNF makes the proxy an exact representation of the common disjunction; existentially forgetting y recovers the original formula.

maxdef_growth_theorem.statement: Let A be a maximum-deficiency sub-clause-set of F that contains at least one compressed block clause, and assume the r input variables are exclusive to the compressed block throughout F. Then the transformed copies of A's original clauses, even before selecting any definition clauses, have deficiency delta(A)+(r-1). Consequently delta*(T(F))>=delta*(F)+(r-1).
proof: Because A contains a block clause and the r input variables are exclusive to the block, all r input variables occur in A.

In the transformed copy A', every occurrence of those r variables inside the block is replaced by one fresh proxy y, and the r input variables do not occur in any untransformed clause of A by exclusivity.
Thus A' has exactly the same number of clauses as A and exactly r-1 fewer variables: r input variables disappear and one y appears.
A' is itself a valid sub-clause-set of the full Tseitin-extended CNF, so maximum deficiency of the transformed formula is at least this value. Definition clauses are not needed for the lower bound.

R44BD_effect.meaning: Compressing an exclusive repeated multi-literal disjunction into one shared functional proxy can reduce syntactic repetition while increasing maximum deficiency because it removes variable-side matching capacity from the witness.
R44BD_effect.r2_case: For a shared pair proxy y iff (a OR b), any maxdef witness touching the exclusive compressed block yields at least +1 maximum-deficiency debt.
R44BD_effect.general_case: For r exclusive inputs, the witnessed increase is r-1.

not_covered: input variables that also occur outside the compressed block
mixed witnesses where the maximum-deficiency witness avoids the compressed block
semantic simplification deleting other clauses after proxy introduction
arbitrary multi-input functional gadgets not based on exclusive common-subexpression replacement

next_admissible_math.question: Attack the genuinely mixed case where functional auxiliary inputs remain elsewhere in the formula and the proxy may exploit cross-branch semantic sharing; prove maxdef descent or an exact barrier for one fixed mixed-input gadget.
